caseNameFull: National City Bank of New York City v. Oelbermann
attorneys: Baltimore & C. Line v. Redman, 295 U. S. 654. Messrs. Carl A. Mead and Frank A. F. Severance for petitioner. Messrs. Kenneth E. Walser and Ralph B. Evans for respondents.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Petition for writ of certiorari granted. The judgment is modified by substituting a direction for a judgment of dismissal on"the merits with costs in place of the direction for a new trial, and, as so modified, is affirmed.
